== Notes ==
* Poison [[cover]]s weakness, which covers disease.
* Combine with [[Epidemic]] or with teammates using [[Fevered Dreams]] and/or [[Extend Conditions]] to rapidly spread the effects of Virulence.
* [[Glyph of Immolation]]'s burning is sufficient to trigger Virulence's effects.
* Can be used with [[Fragility]] for a spike at zero Death Magic.
* This is one of only two [[Condition#Skills that can inflict two or more conditions|player skills that can generate three new conditions]] without spreading them from other foes or from self (the other being [[Shockwave]]).
